evidence.name: Screen field: Purchase button icon
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Purchase button icon" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Purchase button icon
sections.description: Optionally shows a small image next to the button label, to the left or right of the text. Upload an icon, then set its size and the spacing around it. A lock or arrow icon can reinforce the action, but a clean text-only button works just as well.
